dataset_paper.authors: Benedek Kurdi, Shayn Lozano, Mahzarin R. Banaji
dataset_paper.title: Introducing the Open Affective Standardized Image Set (OASIS)

alterations: None; byte-for-byte copy of the original OASIS stimulus. Cropping/scaling for diagram display may be performed via an SVG image viewport without changing this asset.
reuse_basis: The original dataset paper describes free use, reuse and modification of the images in online and offline research. OSF API returned no machine-readable dataset license. Do not assert a blanket CC license based on third-party repository claims.
higher_resolution_search: Photographer originals depicting the same scene were located, but exact correspondence to the dataset stimulus could not be established. The canonical 500 x 400 dataset stimulus is recommended for scientific fidelity.
